name: EADX-100
description: EADX-100 entity list maintained by Unión de Radioaficionados Españoles (URE). Used as a multiplier source by URE-sponsored contests (King of Spain CW/SSB, EA RTTY, etc.). The list is largely a superset of ARRL DXCC with a handful of additional entities (Sicily IT9, Shetland GM/s, Bear JW/b, ITU Vienna 4U1V, etc.) that are recognized by URE for award purposes.
